Two companies get the exact same lead on a Friday night.

Company A lets the form submission sit in an inbox over the weekend. On Tuesday, a rep finally calls. No answer.

Company B routes that submission straight into a CRM. An automated SMS goes out in 60 seconds, inviting the lead to pick a time on a calendar. By Monday morning, the meeting is already on the schedule.

The lead didn't choose Company B because of better marketing. They chose them because they answered first.
